The appendix of Block Diffusion RooflinesPrevious: 9 · ConclusionNext: B · Symbols

This appendix says where the cost model lives and lists the sources of the model shapes and accelerator specifications. The exact accounting behind the maps, the headline numbers and the calculator is at the end of Part 4.

Cost model and last update

The cost model is the BDModel script in /assets/roofline/note.js, which every chapter loads. Last updated 16 November 2026: excerpts of the measurement code in Parts 6–9.

Sources

  • Models: google/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it (config and safetensors headers) and the config.json of each preset on Hugging Face.
  • Forward pass and self-conditioning: transformers modular_diffusion_gemma.py.
  • Sampler: DiffusionGemma docs.
  • Hardware: vendor datasheets and documentation, including Google TPU7x, TPU v6e and the AMD MI325X datasheet; figures marked ≈ are derived or disputed.
  • Roofline: Williams, Waterman and Patterson, "Roofline: an insightful visual performance model", CACM 2009.
  • Block diffusion: Arriola et al., "Block Diffusion", ICLR 2025.
  • Measurements (Parts 6–9): vLLM 0.28.0 and the roofscope harness on one H200 SXM; related work is listed in Part 9.
